tagline: Tableware thrown by hand in Leith
intro: Plates, bowls and cups made in small batches, and wheel classes for beginners in our studio by the water.
about_title: One potter, one wheel, a lot of plates
about:
Ingrid Oda trained in Kyoto and Stoke-on-Trent before opening the studio in 2016. Everything is thrown on the wheel, trimmed by hand and glazed in one of three colours mixed in the studio.

The work is made to be used every day. It stacks, it goes in the dishwasher, and it gets better with a few years of breakfasts behind it.

services.name: Beginner wheel class
services.description: Two and a half hours at the wheel. We fire and glaze your two best pieces.

services.name: Six-week course
services.description: One evening a week, from centring clay to a finished set of bowls.

services.name: Tableware
services.description: Plates, bowls, cups and jugs from the current batch, in the shop and online.

services.name: Restaurant commissions
services.description: Tableware designed with your kitchen and made in runs of forty or more.

services.name: Private sessions
services.description: The studio to yourselves for birthdays and small groups of up to eight.

values.title: Small batches
values.text: No more than sixty pieces in a firing, each one checked by hand.

values.title: Made to be used
values.text: Stoneware fired hot enough for daily use and the dishwasher.

values.title: Local clay where we can
values.text: Our stoneware body comes from a supplier forty miles away.

process.title: Throw
process.text: Each piece is shaped on the wheel from a weighed ball of clay.

process.title: Trim
process.text: A day later the foot is cut and the surface smoothed.

process.title: Glaze
process.text: After a first firing, pieces are dipped in glaze mixed in the studio.

process.title: Fire
process.text: A final firing at 1,240 degrees makes the piece strong and watertight.

faq.a: None. The beginner class starts from the very first step and there are only six of you.

faq.q: When do I get my pieces?
faq.a: About three weeks after your class. You can collect them or we can post them.

faq.q: Can it go in the dishwasher?
faq.a: Yes. All our tableware is dishwasher and microwave safe.
Yes, for classes or for the shop. They are valid for a year.
